items.source: For concrete usage, check out the SchedulerFactoryBean and SchedulerAccessorBean classes.
items.translation: 对于具体用法，请查看 SchedulerFactoryBean 和 SchedulerAccessorBean 类。

items.source:
This is not necessary when a Trigger determines the JobDetail
itself: In this case, the JobDetail will be implicitly registered
in combination with the Trigger.
items.translation: 当触发器（Trigger）本身确定作业详情（JobDetail）时，则不需要这样做：在这种情况下，作业详情将与触发器一起被隐式注册。

items.source:
If the Trigger determines the corresponding JobDetail itself,
the job will be automatically registered with the Scheduler.
Else, the respective JobDetail needs to be registered via the
"jobDetails" property of this FactoryBean.
items.translation: 如果触发器自行确定对应的 JobDetail，则该任务将自动注册到调度器中。否则，需要通过此 FactoryBean 的 "jobDetails" 属性注册相应的 JobDetail。

items.source: Register jobs and triggers (within a transaction, if possible).
items.translation: 注册作业和触发器（如果可能，在事务中）。

items.source: Register all specified listeners with the Scheduler.
items.translation: 将所有指定的监听器注册到调度器中。

items.source:
Register a list of Quartz Calendar objects with the Scheduler
that this FactoryBean creates, to be referenced by Triggers.
items.translation: 将一组 Quartz 日历对象注册到此 FactoryBean 创建的 Scheduler，以便由 Trigger 引用。

items.source: Specify Quartz SchedulerListeners to be registered with the Scheduler.
items.translation: 指定要注册到调度器的 Quartz 调度器监听器。

items.source:
Set whether any jobs defined on this SchedulerFactoryBean should overwrite
existing job definitions. Default is "false", to not overwrite already
registered jobs that have been read in from a persistent job store.
items.translation: 设置是否应覆盖此 `SchedulerFactoryBean` 上定义的任意作业现有的作业定义。默认值为 `"false"`，即不覆盖已从持久化作业存储中读取的已注册作业。

items.source:
Set the location of a Quartz job definition XML file that follows the
"job_scheduling_data_1_5" XSD or better. Can be specified to automatically
register jobs that are defined in such a file, possibly in addition
to jobs defined directly on this SchedulerFactoryBean.
items.translation: 设置 Quartz 作业定义 XML 文件的位置，该文件需遵循 "job_scheduling_data_1_5" XSD 或更高版本。可指定以自动注册此类文件中定义的作业，可能还会补充直接在此 SchedulerFactoryBean 上定义的作业。

items.source:
Set the locations of Quartz job definition XML files that follow the
"job_scheduling_data_1_5" XSD or better. Can be specified to automatically
register jobs that are defined in such files, possibly in addition
to jobs defined directly on this SchedulerFactoryBean.
items.translation: 设置遵循 "job_scheduling_data_1_5" XSD 或更高版本的 Quartz 作业定义 XML 文件的位置。可以指定以自动注册此类文件中定义的作业，可能还会直接在此 SchedulerFactoryBean 上定义的作业之外进行注册。

items.source:
Specify global Quartz JobListeners to be registered with the Scheduler.
Such JobListeners will apply to all Jobs in the Scheduler.
items.translation: 指定全局 Quartz JobListeners 以注册到调度器。这些 JobListeners 将适用于调度器中的所有作业。

items.source:
Specify global Quartz TriggerListeners to be registered with the Scheduler.
Such TriggerListeners will apply to all Triggers in the Scheduler.
items.translation: 指定全局 Quartz 触发器监听器以注册到调度器。此类触发器监听器将适用于调度器中的所有触发器。

items.source:
Set the transaction manager to be used for registering jobs and triggers
that are defined by this SchedulerFactoryBean. Default is none; setting
this only makes sense when specifying a DataSource for the Scheduler.
items.translation: 设置用于注册由该 SchedulerFactoryBean 定义的作业和触发器的事务管理器。默认值为无；仅在为调度器指定了 DataSource 时，设置此属性才有意义。

items.source:
Template method that determines the Scheduler to operate on.
To be implemented by subclasses.
items.translation: 用于确定要操作的调度器的模板方法。由子类实现。

items.source: calendars - a Map with calendar names as keys as Calendar objects as values
items.translation: calendars - 一个以日历名称为键、Calendar 对象为值的 Map。

items.source: This might be a ResourcePatternResolver, which can be checked through instanceof ResourcePatternResolver. See also the ResourcePatternUtils.getResourcePatternResolver method.
items.translation: 这可能是一个 `ResourcePatternResolver`，可以通过 `instanceof ResourcePatternResolver` 进行检查。另请参阅 `ResourcePatternUtils.getResourcePatternResolver` 方法。

items.source: Invoked after population of normal bean properties but before an init callback like InitializingBean's afterPropertiesSet or a custom init-method. Invoked before ApplicationContextAware's setApplicationContext.
items.translation: 在普通 Bean 属性填充之后、但早于初始化回调（如 `InitializingBean` 的 `afterPropertiesSet` 或自定义的 init-method）之前被调用。在 `ApplicationContextAware` 的 `setApplicationContext` 之前被调用。

items.source: Compatible with Quartz 2.1.4 and higher.
items.translation: 与 Quartz 2.1.4 及更高版本兼容。

items.translation: 设置是否应覆盖此 SchedulerFactoryBean 上定义的作业的任何现有作业定义。

items.source: Set the ResourceLoader that this object runs in.
items.translation: 设置该对象运行的资源加载器。

items.source:
Set the transaction manager to be used for registering jobs and triggers
that are defined by this SchedulerFactoryBean.
items.translation: 设置此 SchedulerFactoryBean 定义的作业和触发器将使用的事务管理器。

items.source:
Register a list of Trigger objects with the Scheduler that
this FactoryBean creates.
items.translation: 将触发器对象列表注册到此 FactoryBean 创建的调度器中。
